about.title: À Propos de Spootfind
about.subtitle: Votre partenaire de confiance pour l'approvisionnement mondial
about.storyContent: Spootfind est né d'une idée simple : rendre l'approvisionnement mondial accessible à tous. Nous connectons les acheteurs du monde entier aux produits tendance des principaux centres de fabrication en Chine, Corée, Japon et plus.
about.missionContent: Démocratiser le commerce mondial en fournissant des solutions d'approvisionnement transparentes, fiables et efficaces pour les entreprises de toutes tailles.
about.value1Desc: Chaque produit et fournisseur est vérifié pour la qualité
about.value2Desc: Prix clairs, communication honnête, sans frais cachés
about.step1Desc: Explorez notre sélection des produits les plus vendus sur Amazon, TikTok Shop, Etsy et plus.
about.step2Desc: Utilisez notre calculatrice intégrée pour voir les coûts exacts, l'expédition et les marges avant d'acheter.
about.step3Desc: Contactez directement des fournisseurs vérifiés et passez vos commandes en toute confiance.
about.faqA1: Nous travaillons avec des fabricants vérifiés principalement en Chine, en Corée du Sud et au Japon. Chaque fournisseur est audité pour la qualité et la capacité de production.
about.faqQ2: Quelles sont les quantités minimum de commande?
about.faqA2: Les quantités minimum varient selon le produit, généralement à partir de 20-50 unités. Nous travaillons avec les petits acheteurs et les commandes en gros.
about.faqQ3: Combien de temps prend l'expédition internationale?
about.faqA3: L'expédition aérienne prend généralement 7-14 jours; l'expédition maritime prend 25-40 jours. Nous travaillons avec les principaux transporteurs.
about.faqQ4: Y a-t-il une garantie de qualité?
about.faqA4: Nous offrons un service de vérification de qualité pour les commandes de plus de 500$. Nous offrons également un soutien à la résolution des litiges.
about.storyExpanded: Depuis nos debuts, nous nous engageons a connecter les acheteurs du monde entier avec les meilleurs fournisseurs chinois, offrant des produits tendance avec qualite garantie et prix competitifs.

insights.art2_title: Why the World Is Buying China-Made Mini Excavators
insights.art2_subtitle: From Australian farms to Brazilian construction sites — how Chinese compact equipment is filling a gap the big brands can’t
insights.art2_hotTitle: 🔥 The Price Gap That Changed Everything
insights.art2_hotContent:
A Caterpillar 1.8-ton mini excavator retails for \,000-40,000 in the US and Australia. A Jining-made equivalent with a Kubota engine and CE certification? Factory gate price: \,000-3,800.

Even after shipping (\,000-3,000 per unit in a 40HQ container), import duties (US 2.5%, EU 3.7%, Australia 5%), and dealer markup — the landed cost is still half or less of what you’d pay for a Cat or Yanmar.

This isn’t a small difference. This is the difference between a small contractor buying one machine versus three. Between a farmer hiring an excavation crew versus doing it themselves.

The market has spoken: China’s compact construction equipment exports surged 24.3% in Q1 2026, with mini excavators leading the charge. 3-ton-and-below models are the #1 seller in Brazil, Indonesia, and Vietnam.
insights.art2_profitContent:
The buyers aren’t just developing nations. Three distinct customer profiles are driving demand:

🌾 Australian & New Zealand Farmers
A typical 500-acre livestock farm needs trenching, fence-post holes, and land clearing. A Kubota-branded 1.8T excavator costs AUD 45,000-55,000 locally. A Chinese equivalent with the same Kubota engine? AUD 18,000-22,000 landed. Many Australian farmers are already importing directly. RCM certification and AS/NZS compliance are required — but Jining factories now offer pre-certified models specifically for the ANZ market.

🏗️ Belt & Road Contractors
Chinese infrastructure projects across Africa, Central Asia, and Southeast Asia prefer Chinese equipment for parts compatibility and service network coverage. When a road project in Kazakhstan needs 10 mini excavators, the procurement logic is simple: same performance, 60% less capital tied up, spare parts in 48 hours instead of 6 weeks.

🏠 North American Landscapers & Property Owners
The “YouTube effect” is real. Videos of American and Canadian property owners unboxing Chinese mini excavators have millions of views. These buyers are not replacing Cat on commercial job sites — they’re buying their first machine for personal use. At \,900 retail (vs \,000+ for a name brand), it’s an impulse purchase, not a capital decision.
insights.art2_regionContent:
Jining, Shandong Province is not just another manufacturing hub — it’s the world’s densest cluster for compact construction equipment:

• 200+ factories within 50km — competition keeps prices honest and quality improving fast
• Complete vertical integration: engines (Kubota/Honda partnerships), hydraulics, undercarriages, cabs — all sourced locally
• 800km from Qingdao port — one of China’s busiest heavy-equipment export terminals, with weekly sailings to Australia, Middle East, and South America
• 48-hour spare-parts shipping — the #1 concern for overseas buyers
• CE, EPA, ISO 9001 are standard on export models; RCM (Australia) available on request

Jining factories have spent the last 5 years upgrading from “cheap but unreliable” to “affordable and dependable.” The core realization: they’re not competing with Caterpillar on brand — they’re competing on value for the 80% of use cases where a Cat is overkill.
insights.art2_tipsTitle: 📦 Before You Import: 6 Things to Get Right
insights.art2_tipsContent:
1. Match the machine to your market’s certification — CE for EU, EPA for US, RCM for Australia. Ask the factory for certificate copies upfront.

2. Choose Kubota or Honda engine models — not “generic diesel.” Parts availability worldwide is non-negotiable.

3. Request a video factory tour — Jining factories that export regularly will accommodate this without hesitation. If they won’t, find one that will.

4. Start with one unit — Test the market before ordering a container. Use Alibaba Trade Assurance to protect your deposit.

5. Calculate total landed cost — Machine + shipping + duties + insurance. A \,500 excavator becomes \,500-7,000 landed depending on your country. Still 50-70% below Cat/Kubota retail.

6. Order spare parts with your first shipment — Bucket teeth, filters, drive belts. 10-15% extra on the first order saves weeks of downtime later.
